g.text: View Order, Payment, and Delivery Status
Verify payment server-side; a redirect alone is not proof.
Book delivery only after payment succeeds. Pickup bypasses delivery.
Controlled Django administration for oversight and correction,
NOT the vendor's own product management - see UC21.
Vendor self-service: create/update own products, price,
availability, stock, and images. Matches the project idea
document (key feature 6). Admin retains oversight via UC30.
Cash payment is a PAYMENT EVENT, not a status transition.
It records Payment(provider = CASH, status = VERIFIED) and
Order.status is not changed by taking cash.
Confirm pickup accepts CONFIRMED, PREPARING or READY_FOR_PICKUP
and advances Order.status to COMPLETED. Cash may already have
been taken (UC23) or may be taken at the same moment.
Delivery orders only. OUT_FOR_DELIVERY + DeliveryBooking IN_TRANSIT,
This is the only path by which a delivery order reaches COMPLETED.
